task: Multiple workers are corrupting shared_state. Fix the synchronization so writes are safe.

candidate_memories.content: Corruption confirmed: workers in worker_pool.go are writing to shared_state concurrently without holding the mutex.
shared_state in worker_pool.go is guarded by mu sync.RWMutex; all write paths must call mu.Lock() and defer mu.Unlock().
Read paths may use mu.RLock(); only write paths require the exclusive Lock to prevent data races.
PostgreSQL row-level lock timeout is 5 s in database.yml; increase if workers hold locks too long.
candidate_memories.notes: note: uses 'lock' surface term but means DB row lock

candidate_memories.content: Redis distributed lock TTL is 30 s for task coordination; implemented with SET NX EX in task_queue.go.
